hook.name: ForgeHookV4
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for controlled token launches that enforces a structured initialization and single-position liquidity process through a designated launch manager. Applies configurable buy/sell fees (up to 5–15% depending on mode) on swaps via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta, distributing proceeds to platform, creator, rewards, and utility recipients. Liquidity removal and donations are permanently disabled.
